protocol.selection: 27 anonymous examples stratified across arms/panels/seeds; identity mapping withheld from reviewer
protocol.method: The AI reviewer independently read all 27 anonymous prompts, solved each sum/subtraction/leading-zero normalization, and checked the actual output format and EOS termination. Explicit item judgments are recorded below.
protocol.rubric: One canonical decimal integer, 1..4 characters, no whitespace or plus sign or leading zeros or -0; eos termination is necessary for format validity; correct additionally requires equality to the independently solved target.
limitations: This is actual AI-assisted review, not human review or a verified independent human audit.
Only the selected 27 anonymous examples were reviewed; this subset does not establish complete boundary coverage or population accuracy.
Arm/seed/checkpoint identity mapping and cached automatic scores were withheld and were not read.
